digest.component_or_area: plan-review health visibility and audit rendering
propositions: Pin drift, enforcement posture, and review-phase compatibility must be surfaced in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit output, close errors, web UI) without cluttering ordinary list output or persisting warning events.

DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract must be consumed consistently across all detailed renderers; each must display canonical related ticket, role, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, signed phase, required phase, and execution floor without recreating independent status strings.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at the build_context/page-assembly boundary after audit_trail produces stored data, catch failures without raising, and label derived-health unavailable if attestation is missing, output unexpected, or compute times out.

When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift must be labeled as advisory; legacy-unpinned must be distinguishable from current-no-relationships; ordinary list output and persisted ticket events must remain unchanged.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must be updated for pins, phases, toggles, deleted targets, and close-versus-claim freshness; basic user documentation must exclude pin-enforcement detail.
